description: A MANAGEMENT message whose EOW subtype is not recognised is acknowledged, answered with an UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR EOW and draws WARNING reason 0, once for a message sent twice.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 2000, two copies of a MANAGEMENT D_PDU (type 6) from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.2, address size 4, EOT 10 (end 7000), VALID MESSAGE 1, ACK 0, frame ID 9, EOW 0x7AB: EOW type 7, RESERVED (C-0405), a subtype this node does not recognise. The first copy is a new message: it is acknowledged (C-0296), its EOW is answered with UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR for type 7, EOW 0x307, owed to 0.0.1.3 (C-0445, C-0447, C-1079), and it draws WARNING reason 0, Unrecognised D_PDU type, RECEIVED FRAME TYPE 6 (J-0035, J-0036, J-0054, J-0081). The second copy has the same frame ID, so it is a repeat (C-0316): its acknowledgement is already queued (C-1074) and, not being a new message, it draws no second WARNING (J-0081). No WTRP evidence, so the analysis reports nothing. Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (both copies addressed only to this node), CONT_WAIT 45000; at 52000 the acknowledgement (type 6, ACK 1, VALID MESSAGE 0, frame ID 9, address size 3, EOW 0x307, the first D_PDU sent to 0.0.1.3, C-1079) then the WARNING (EOW 0), management first (C-0297, C-1041), EOT 10 each (one block, duration 5550).
